Container.Name: OpenDVR
Container.Overview: Self-hosted live TV and DVR for HDHomeRun tuners. One tuner session per channel is shared by any number of viewers, each with their own pause and rewind. Hardware transcoding with Intel Quick Sync. Pass through /dev/dri for hardware encoding.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the web UI and API.

Config.Name: HDHomeRun hosts
Config.Description: Comma separated IPs of your HDHomeRun tuners, e.g. 192.168.1.50. Required in bridge mode or when the tuner is across a VPN.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent settings and database.

Config.Name: Live buffer
Config.Description: Ring buffer for live TV. Put this on cache/NVMe, never on the array.

Config.Name: Recordings
Config.Description: Where DVR recordings are stored, as Show/Show - S01E02 - Episode.mp4. The array is fine; files are written once.

Config.Name: Encoder
Config.Description: auto, qsv, vaapi or software. auto picks Quick Sync when /dev/dri is present.

Config.Name: Buffer minutes
Config.Description: How many minutes of live TV each tuned channel keeps for pause and rewind.

Config.Name: Video bitrate (kbit/s)
Config.Description: Transcode target bitrate for 1080i broadcast.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: debug, info, warn or error.

Config.Name: Segment seconds
Config.Description: HLS segment length. 1 gives the fastest channel changes.

Config.Name: Auth issuer
Config.Description: OpenID Connect issuer, e.g. https://auth.example.com/application/o/opendvr/ (Authentik). Leave empty to keep the server open on the LAN.

Config.Name: Auth client id
Config.Description: OIDC client id from the Authentik provider.

Config.Name: Auth client secret
Config.Description: OIDC client secret from the Authentik provider.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: How browsers reach this server, e.g. https://tv.example.com. The OIDC redirect URI is this plus /auth/callback.

Config.Name: MCP token
Config.Description: Bearer token the /mcp endpoint accepts when auth is on (for the Claude connector).

Config.Name: Allowed group
Config.Description: Authentik group required to sign in at all. Empty allows every user the application is assigned to.

Config.Name: DVR padding before (min)
Config.Description: Minutes a recording starts before the listed time.

Config.Name: DVR padding after (min)
Config.Description: Minutes a recording runs past the listed end.

Config.Name: Commercial detection
Config.Description: Leave empty to use the bundled comskip; set to off to never detect commercials.

Config.Name: Recordings cap (GB)
Config.Description: Keep the recordings folder under this many GB; 0 is no cap. Watched recordings are removed first.

Config.Name: Tuner for Plex/Jellyfin
Config.Description: true serves an HDHomeRun-compatible tuner (discover.json, lineup.json, streams) so Plex, Jellyfin or Emby can add this server.

Config.Name: Notification webhook
Config.Description: URL that receives a JSON POST when a recording fails or conflicts (ntfy, Gotify, Discord, Slack, Home Assistant).

Config.Name: Notify when ready
Config.Description: Also notify when a recording finishes.

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: Mail server for notifications; leave empty to use only the webhook.

Config.Name: SMTP user
Config.Description: Mail login.

Config.Name: SMTP password
Config.Description: Mail password.

Config.Name: Notification email
Config.Description: Comma separated recipients.

Config.Name: Closed captions
Config.Description: Extract closed captions from recordings.

Config.Name: User id (PUID)
Config.Description: Account the server runs as after start-up. 99 is nobody.

Config.Name: Group id (PGID)
Config.Description: Group the server runs as. 100 is users.

Config.Name: Admin group
Config.Description: Authentik group that gets the Admin page (audit log, who is watching, connectors). Empty uses the MCP group.

Config.Name: MCP group
Config.Description: Authentik group required to use the MCP endpoint (the Claude connector).
